shortDescription: Manage NTP configuration on Junos devices.

options.name: comment
options.description: Commit comment to be associated with the configuration changes. This allows tracking the reason for configuration changes (e.g., change management ticket).

options.name: running_config
options.description: This option is used only with state I(parsed). The value of this option should be the output received from the Junos device by executing the command B(show system syslog). The state I(parsed) reads the configuration from C(running_config) option and transforms it into Ansible structured data as per the resource module's argspec and the value is then returned in the I(parsed) key within the result.

options.name: state
options.description: The state the configuration should be left in. The states I(replaced) and I(overridden) have identical behaviour for this module. Refer to examples for more details.
